Preface to the Second Edition 
Unlike most pocket Constitutions, this one is designed to 
be read.

text: The Constitution is not so simple that it explains itself, nor so complex that only experts can understand it.
text_raw:
The Constitution is not so simple that it explains itself, nor 
so complex that only experts can understand it.

text: Political organizations like to hand out cheap pocket Constitutions with tiny lettering and zero explanation.

Constitutions with tiny lettering and zero explanation.

text: Poli- ticians like to wave them in the air.

ticians like to wave them in the air.

text: They seldom get read.

text: This book is designed to get you started on the Constitution as a text and as a way to start understanding the American Constitutional system.

text: It contains a summary of what experts assume you already know.
